title: @mention is a signal, not a wake: thanks and passing-along mentions stay silent; a mentioned question is answered by that agent only

turns.prompt: @lane-b has the notes from yesterday, I'll ask them later
@lane-b can you tell @lane-a that the sync moved to 4 pm?

regression: Jacob 2026-10-26/27: an @mention is a consideration signal, never an automatic wake; 'thanks @x' and a mention passing information along are silence; the agent named as the object of a request to another agent does not answer that request.
